CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_RISKRATINGTYPE_CRM
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType AS 
(SELECT
        BCC.[VALUE] AS RiskRatingTypeId
        ,BCC.DESCRIPTION AS RiskRatingTypeName
		,NULL AS RiskRatingTypeDescription
        ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
        ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
        ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
        ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
        ,insert_dttm as InsertDttm
    FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC
        ON BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID
        AND BCCD.CATEGORYID =  BCC.CATEGORYID
        AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
    WHERE BCC.CATEGORYTYPE = 'CBC_RATING_TYPE'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType FROM TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType;


WITH
TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_SRC AS
(SELECT 
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(RiskRatingTypeId,RiskRatingTypeName,FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId)) HASHROW
		,RiskRatingTypeId
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,CategoryId
		,RECORD_STATUS
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType
	WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'),

TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_TGT AS
(	SELECT
		HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(RiskRatingTypeId,RiskRatingTypeName,FinancialInstitutionId,CategoryId)) HASHROW
		,RiskRatingTypeId
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,CategoryId
	 FROM BNKM.RiskRatingType
	 WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'),

TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_DELTA AS 
(	SELECT
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,ISNULL(SRC.RiskRatingTypeId,TGT.RiskRatingTypeId) AS RiskRatingTypeId
		,CASE WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	FROM TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_SRC SRC
	FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_TGT TGT
		ON SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
		AND SRC.CategoryId = TGT.CategoryId
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_DELTA;

----UPDATE Record in BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
	RiskRatingTypeId = SRC.RiskRatingTypeId
	,RiskRatingTypeName = SRC.RiskRatingTypeName
	,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
	,CategoryId = SRC.CategoryId
FROM BNKM.RiskRatingType TGT
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_DELTA DELTA
	ON TGT.RiskRatingTypeId = DELTA.RiskRatingTypeId
	AND TGT.FinancialInstitutionId = DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType SRC 
	ON SRC.RiskRatingTypeId = TGT.RiskRatingTypeId
	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId



----INSERT New Record
INSERT INTO BNKM.RiskRatingType (RiskRatingTypeId ,RiskRatingTypeName ,FinancialInstitutionId ,CategoryId ,SourceSystemCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm)
SELECT  
	RiskRatingTypeId
	,RiskRatingTypeName
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
FROM    #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType
WHERE   RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RiskRatingType_DELTA;

END
